figures.title: 今日图表（彭博 Aug 11）— 台币短端看涨期权成交量反超
figures.analysis: 彭博「今日图表」（DTCC / Bloomberg；8月数据截至上周五）把2026年1–8月美元/台币期权成交量拆成看跌台币（橙）与看涨台币（黑），单位为亿美元。1–6月看跌柱整体高于看涨；7月方向反转，看涨柱明显高于看跌；8月（未完月）看涨仍略占优但总量回落。So what：在日韩外汇干预与美元走弱的背景下，市场对台币升值风险的对冲需求上升——这是期权流的领先迹象，不是即期汇率本身的官方定论；对大中华资产，读的是「美元回吐环境下的区域货币再定价」，而非单独的中国政策冲击。

watch: BLS CPI (Aug 12) · PPI (Aug 13) · RBA decision (Aug 11) · US existing-home sales · Hormuz/Iran rhetoric · USD/JPY if authorities re-engage.

themeCards.title: Hormuz reopen hopes fade — oil premium back on
themeCards.fact: Inbox: after Iran sought US compensation, Trump counter-claimed damages; desks say harder stances make a quick Hormuz reopen less likely, with satellite/shipping color that Iran’s main oil export terminals have been nearly stalled since August. Yahoo Brent futures $89.44 (+1.96%).
themeCards.mechanism: Supply-risk premium re-enters energy and feeds inflation-path anxiety into yields ahead of CPI — separate from last week’s soft-labor relief.
themeCards.trigger: Confirmed sustained Hormuz commercial channel with falling freight/war risk.
themeCards.invalidator: Verified reopen + oil drop that pulls front-end yields lower with soft CPI.

themeCards.title: Yen fade into Japan holiday — re-intervention watch
themeCards.fact: Inbox: USD/JPY jumped ~1% Monday and half the post-joint-intervention yen gain has been given back; Japan Tuesday holiday thins liquidity. Yahoo USD/JPY ~159.3.
themeCards.mechanism: Thin holiday books can amplify FX moves and raise the option value of official response — without confirming a second joint intervention.
themeCards.trigger: Confirmed official yen support or sustained USD/JPY break back below 155.
themeCards.invalidator: Smooth grind higher with no official response through the holiday reopen.

themeCards.title: Hammack still sees hikes — CPI is the near falsifier
themeCards.fact: Inbox: Cleveland Fed President Hammack said several rate hikes may still be needed to bring inflation to 2%. Monday US tape: S&P 7,753.11 (−0.06%), 10Y 4.72% (+7 bp) with oil-led inflation concern into Aug 12 CPI.
themeCards.mechanism: Soft July payrolls cut near-term hike odds, but oil + hawkish regional-Fed color keep the path two-sided into the CPI print.
themeCards.trigger: Hot July CPI that lifts Sept hike odds and extends the yield backup.
themeCards.invalidator: Soft CPI that re-anchors front-end relief despite firm oil.

themeCards.title: Nvidia + PE plan huge AI infra spend (desk CLAIM)
themeCards.fact: Inbox CLAIM: Nvidia will partner with Apollo, Blackstone, BlackRock, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to invest $500bn in AI infrastructure. Treat as desk color until primary filings/IR confirm sizing.
themeCards.mechanism: If real, the print is a multi-year AI-capex demand signal for semis and power/infra — but the $500bn headline is not yet a verified IR print here.
themeCards.trigger: Company IR / SEC filing confirming vehicle size and counterparties.
themeCards.invalidator: Clarification that the figure is aspirational marketing, not committed capital.

themeCards.title: China pecan AD deposit — trade friction before summit talk
themeCards.fact: Inbox: China announced an anti-dumping cash deposit on US pecan imports — framed as fresh friction ahead of a possible September leaders’ meeting. Separately, PBOC issued a 15th Five-Year reform plan emphasizing a scientific/stable monetary framework and RMB internationalization (desk).
themeCards.mechanism: Sector-specific trade measures keep a tariff-risk premium alive even when equity beta is driven by US path-odds and AI flows.
themeCards.trigger: Broader US–China tariff escalation beyond agriculture niches.
themeCards.invalidator: Official de-escalation language with summit confirmation and no follow-on AD cases.

globalRegime: Soft-labor relief meets a fresh oil/geo premium: risk assets hold near highs while yields firm into CPI and USD/JPY tests the credibility of last week’s yen support.

globalChanged.text: 在伊朗要求美国赔偿损失后，特朗普反向索赔。他要求德黑兰赔偿那些因伊朗的路边炸弹和在多场冲突中遇难的所有人，以及过去50年来被伊朗杀害的数十万无辜抗议者的家属。
美伊双方日趋强硬的立场令霍尔木兹海峡尽快重开的希望进一步减弱，原油期货隔夜大涨。卫星图像及数据显示，8月以来伊朗主要石油出口码头几乎陷入停滞，超大型油轮踪影难觅。
日元兑美元周一大跌约1%，美日联合干预所激发的日元涨幅已半数回吐。日本周二适逢公众假期，一些投资者担心，市场流动性下降可能为当局再次干预创造条件。
克利夫兰联储行长表示，可能需要进行数次加息才能将通胀降至2%的目标。特朗普周一则坚称，自沃什担任美联储主席以来，他只与沃什“简短”交谈过一次。
英伟达将与阿波罗、黑石、贝莱德、博枫、高盛和KKR等华尔街机构合作，筹划对人工智能基础设施的大规模投资（彭博早茶，单源 CLAIM；规模待 IR/SEC 确认）。

globalImplies.text: Into Aug 12 CPI, treat Monday’s yield backup as oil/path-odds — not a sealed hike cycle. Soft CPI can still restore front-end relief.
USD/JPY holiday liquidity raises intervention option value; do not confuse a one-day spike with a confirmed policy response.

globalTensions: Soft July NFP vs Hammack “several hikes” color; Hormuz oil premium vs equity high-hold. Nvidia $500bn AI infra figure is inbox CLAIM until IR confirms.
chinaStance: Trade-friction pocket (US pecan AD) ahead of possible Sept summit talk; PBOC medium-term reform framing; A/H tape mixed with Golden Dragon firm (desk).

chinaChanged.text: 中国宣布对自美国进口的碧根果征收反倾销保证金，中美贸易关系在两国元首9月料将举行峰会前夕再添新的摩擦（具体税率见彭博早茶，单源）。
中国央行印发“十五五”改革发展规划，要求构建科学稳健的货币政策体系，完善基础货币投放机制和宏观审慎管理体系，强化金融支持消费，并推进人民币国际化。
宇树科技上海科创板IPO获散户超高倍认购；发行价与募资规模见彭博早茶（单源 CLAIM，待交易所/招股书确认）。
恒生指数公司就恒生科技指数编算方法修订方案征询市场意见，拟扩大科技主题范围、调整成份股挑选机制并增加成份股数目，相关修订预计将不晚于9月底公布。
瑞银证券认为，短期内中国A股市场去杠杆过程或已进入尾声，整体杠杆率可控（彭博早茶第三方观点，CLAIM）。
